turns.query: Give me a quick summary of the Zentro Dynamics Q3 report.
turns.answer:
According to the uploaded 'Zentro Dynamics Q3 FY2025 Investor Report.md', the company reported Q3 FY2025 revenue of Rs 412 crore, up 23% quarter-over-quarter, with gross margin steady at 61% [E1].  
During Q3 FY2025, Zentro Dynamics added 27 new cities, expanding total coverage to 89 cities across India and Southeast Asia [E1].  
Customer metrics showed monthly logo churn at 2.1% (the lowest ever), net revenue retention of 118%, and an NPS of 71 [E1].  
Headcount reached 1,840 employees at quarter end, the firm was founded by Meera Krishnan and is headquartered in Pune, India [E1].  
Orbit Analytics 2.0 launched in September 2025, adding real-time forecasting to the product suite [E1].  
Management guides to FY2026 revenue of Rs 1,900 crore [E1].
